description: The level bound measured on the sample worlds (rendering plan R10, R10.T4.a): for each of R09's six sample worlds, its coarse field from the whole coarse pass under reference::SEED and its ground drawn with detail_seed. elevation_lowest_m and elevation_highest_m are the lowest and highest elevation of every cell of the field (metres above the datum). levels gives, by band level from 0 to complete_level (the band limit's level, from which the bound is zero): R09's level bound bound_m (metres; hard in the structural octaves and the channels, a 1 - 1e-9 per-point quantile in the craters' and the coarse rims' terms; R09.T8); the body's sigma, R09's level-keyed Synthesiser::omitted_rms over up to 16384 cells of the world's coarse level, every k-th in index order (every cell at coarse level 5, every 2nd at 6, 6th at 7, 24th at 8): sigma_m its largest, sigma_rms_m the root of the cells' mean square (each cell weighted alike; metres); and contribution_low_m and contribution_high_m, the most the level's contributions can take from and add to the base elevation (R09's LevelBounds::contribution_range_m; metres), from which, with the cells' elevations, the worker's level table makes a level's lowest and highest height. measured gives, by level below complete_level, the bound's looseness: p999_over_bound, the 99.9th percentile (nearest rank) over the uniform points of |h(n) - h(c)| over bound_m, c the complete level; p999_over_4sigma_cell, the same over 4 sigma of the point's own cell; worst_over_bound, the largest |h(n) - h(m)| over bound_m for any finer m at any point, uniform or extra, at worst_finer_level, with worst_term the contribution (relief, channels, craters or rims) whose change made most of it and worst_term_share that change over the whole, the three null where no point's height differs from c's; and over patches distinct random patches of the level (65 x 65 vertices each, level n's heights baked and c's queried): patch_max_over_bound, the largest per-patch maximum of |h(n) - h(c)| over bound_m, patch_median_over_bound the lower median's, patch_spread the largest over the median (null where the median is zero), patches_over_4sigma the patches whose maximum passes 4 sigma of their own (the largest omitted_rms over the cells their vertices lie in), and patches_over_4sigma_body those whose maximum passes 4 sigma_m. Written by crates/hyperion-sim/tests/level_bound_worlds.rs under HYPERION_BLESS=1 and checked byte for byte otherwise; never edit it by hand. Measured at generator_version 23: the coarse fields move at 24 by plan 14's T53.a water term, and R10.T15.b re-records the figures there.
